scope: Existing canonical Poaceae hybrid accepted name, parent formula, four heterotypic synonyms and cross-backbone conflict only

decisions.reason: POWO/WCVP accepts a named interspecific hybrid published in Bot. Zeitung (Berlin) 19:341 (1861). Retain one canonical hybrid entry, not an ordinary nonhybrid species.
POWO accepts C. cucullata as distinct and gives the hybrid formula C. cucullata × C. verticillata. The parent has its own canonical learner card; no merge.
POWO accepts C. verticillata separately and identifies it as the second parent. Do not conflate the species itself with its historical varieties now synonymized under the hybrid.
POWO/WCVP lists this as a heterotypic synonym, not a separately accepted species or hybrid card.
POWO/WCVP treats this as a heterotypic synonym; EPPO currently prefers C. latisquamea, so preserve the authority conflict separately and do not claim universal consensus.

decisions.source_name: Chloris verticillata var. aristulata Torr. & A.Gray (1857)
decisions.reason: POWO/WCVP lists the historical variety as a heterotypic synonym of the hybrid, not of modern accepted C. verticillata; rank and authorship must be retained in source crosswalk.
POWO/WCVP lists the historical variety as a heterotypic synonym of the hybrid. Historical specimen identity still needs individual review.

decisions.accepted_target: Documented natural Chloris cucullata × C. verticillata hybrid concept
decisions.reason: USDA NRCS primary release confirms naturally occurring seed-producing hybrid, parent formula, and accession 9085260 / PI 645601. This is evidence for a real hybrid taxon, not verification of the learner's specific photographed individual.

decisions.source_name: Proposed separate accepted learner for Chloris latisquamea or Chloris brevispica under POWO backbone
decisions.reason: Both are POWO heterotypic synonyms of already installed C. × subdolichostachya; the EPPO preference is a backbone conflict to retain, not permission to install a duplicate. FAIL applies to proposed duplicate mapping only.

decisions.source_name: Existing source-labelled iNaturalist Chloris × subdolichostachya photo
decisions.reason: POWO accepted formula and USDA authenticated release do not establish the parentage of the installed photo; keep source determination provisional until same-plant reproductive anatomy and/or specimen determination supports it.

decisions.source_name: Historical specimens identified as C. verticillata var. aristulata / var. intermedia
decisions.reason: Backbone synonymy does not authenticate a particular herbarium specimen or photographed individual; do not retroactively relabel historical vouchers solely from synonymy.

decisions.source_name: EPPO preferred Chloris latisquamea Nash versus POWO accepted Chloris × subdolichostachya Müll.Hal.
decisions.reason: EPPO (code CHRLS) prefers C. latisquamea and lists C. × subdolichostachya as another name, whereas POWO/WCVP accepts the hybrid under the older C. × subdolichostachya and synonymizes C. × latisquamea. This is a live source-backbone disagreement, not evidence that the learner needs renaming or duplicate installation.

limitations: POWO and EPPO use different preferred names; maintain explicit UNRESOLVED authority flag, no silent rename.
Historical synonym mapping is not specimen authentication.
